intro: Football is the most popular sport, and the national team plays in Asian competitions.

chapters.title: Football
text: Palestine joined FIFA in 1998. The men's team reached the Asian Cup for the first time in 2015 and the knockout stage in 2024. Because of travel restrictions, the team often plays home games abroad.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Palestine has sent athletes to every Summer Olympics since 1996. Running events like the Palestine Marathon in Bethlehem draw international runners.
